capabilities: Render configurable controls (sliders, color pickers, dropdowns, class toggles) for /* @settings variables declared by themes, snippets, and plugin CSS
Switch color mode and theme and toggle CSS snippets from a settings tab or standalone view
Search settings by variable name and copy variable names to the clipboard
Export and import customized settings per section
Run 66 bundled Markdown lint and formatting rules via commands, on save, on file switch, or on paste
extras: Warns not to enable it together with Style Settings, since both render the same /* @settings panels and conflicting values may be written twice. Installation is via BRAT or manual file copy; uninstalling deletes data.json and data-linter.json, so exporting a backup first is advised. Documentation is primarily in Chinese with English in key sections.
intentEvidence: It is an independently maintained fork of Style Settings by mgmeyers, licensed under GPL-3.0.
problem: Themes, snippets, and plugin CSS can declare configurable variables through /* @settings blocks, but Obsidian has no built-in panel to adjust them without hand-editing CSS.
